"Married people want freedom
Single want love
The young want to grow up
The old wish to be young again
Famous ones want privacy

Human nature often traps us in the illusion that fulfillment lies in whatever stage of life we haven’t reached yet. When we are single, we crave companionship; when settled, we miss autonomy. The grass always looks greener on the other side until you realize the soil is different everywhere. Real peace begins when you stop measuring your current chapter against someone else's highlight reel. Protect your peace, appreciate where your feet are planted today, and celebrate the quiet blessings you already hold.
